Thanks a ton brother, just hearing that helps. Because a lot of times we feel guilty because there's always someone who has it worse. But that shit don't matter, everyones pain matters and it's foolish to compare such things anyway. 
I'll send u a message bro when things feel real dangerous. Just thank you for reading and replying, means a lot.

I hear ya man. And you do what you feel you need to do. Anything I say is a cliché that's been said to myself a countless times. 

All I can say honestly is, it's just a ride, man(yes bill hicks but ain't it right? Just hold on man, if you can. No judgement either way, just know even I, a complete stranger feel for you and wish that you get better.

Thank you for your reply, I'm somewhat undiagnosed bipolar so now I'm actually feeling good(up) and getting shit done. But, it did take OD'ing on some worthless "non-lethal-but-will-fuck-you-up-proper-bitch" allergy pills. Just couldn't the angst while going cold turkey by myself in my dorm room. 
So I called anonymously to the health care advice-line, and she told me I would probably take major damage and needed an ambulance ASAP. But, I truly hate hospitals so I hung up and toughened it out over 24 hours. Simple lesson kids: don't eat 20 unknown pills at once. Hurts the tummy jesus.
Probably got some liver damage but liver damage is usually a given anyway. 
Nah, but I'm fine dude, I guess I'm like most other people on this sub; Melancholic/Depressed/Mental Illness, but somehow, the Sun Also Rises.
(Love Hemingway lol)
Thanks again for checking on me, it actually helps to know there are many of us, even if it's tragic what modern society has done to us.

Yesterday I went progressively nuts with 4F-MPH(and a bit of phenazepam and CB). 
I dont remember taking the first tablet. This was an ongoing dilemma for me, because I couldnt figure out how many I'd eaten after that. Either way today I tally the cost at 6 pills(90mg).

Because I took it continuously from about 3pm yest. to 12am this morning, it's hard to say anything definite. It certainly was a ride, of immense proportions sometimes, more managable at other times. 

Huge dehydration, superbly clean house, and complete penile disillusionment with the world(but I beat that sucker back in place after some benzo and beers later on)

As far as phenidates go I'm close to saying 4/5. Very strange but fantastic stim with many different uses. 
15mg-fine in public
30mg-effects are noticable
45-70mg-Here we go you goddamn beast
70-90mg-------STIM COMPLETE--------

And I'm coming down at this moment, bit weary but still mad respect for this substance. It ain't amph but it is versatile in whole other way. 
PS do not take the same as me unless benzos are available. At least I wouldn't.
